question: On unseen analytic two-layer sequences with exact ground truth, can two independent implementations produce the exact same history-validity mask and ghost-free float32 temporal accumulation, then survive the D8 Blender 5.2 Raw EXR bridge unchanged?

normativeSources.use: Depth is nearest visible-surface distance; Vector contains next/previous screen-space motion pairs; alpha threshold affects data-pass surface ownership
Depth clipping explicitly marks disocclusion; motion-vector scale/direction and reactive regions are first-class temporal inputs
Temporal supersampling requires reprojection plus history validation/clamping rather than unconditional frame blending

coordinateAndValidityContract.motionStorage: current-pixel screen-space integer displacement (dx,dy) in float32
coordinateAndValidityContract.sampling: nearest integer only in D9; subpixel filtering is intentionally excluded
coordinateAndValidityContract.layerOwnership: current float32 layerId equals previous layerId at q exactly
coordinateAndValidityContract.depth: positive camera distance; background sentinel is 1e10
coordinateAndValidityContract.alphaAgreement: both alpha values are greater than zero
coordinateAndValidityContract.historyValid: inBounds AND layerOwnership AND depthAgreement AND alphaAgreement
coordinateAndValidityContract.canonicalIdentity: SHA-256 of top-left row-major little-endian float32 bytes; validity mask uses one byte per pixel

analyticConstruction.cleanTarget: piecewise-constant two-layer RGBA image at the current frame
analyticConstruction.validPixelNoise: current and correctly reprojected previous colors receive equal-and-opposite binary-exact noise, so their 0.5 average equals cleanTarget exactly
analyticConstruction.wrongHistory: unvalidated previous color intentionally differs across ownership/depth boundaries
analyticConstruction.groundTruth: both the history-validity mask and clean resolved image are generated directly from layer trajectories, not inferred from the accumulator output

fixtures.layers: near red foreground rectangle depth=1 crosses static blue background depth=4
near patterned foreground depth=2 over far patterned background depth=8
crossing surfaces intentionally share layerId=7 but use depths 1 and 4
unchanged two-layer composition with complementary valid-pixel noise

naiveUnconditionalHistory.definition: use reprojected previous color wherever q is in bounds, ignoring layerId and depth

wrongMotionSign.definition: q=(x+dx,y-dy) while every other rule remains unchanged

decisionRule.supported: All exact gates, sensitivity controls and 29 attacks pass.
decisionRule.notSupported: Any gate fails; preserve the counterexample and do not connect Blender production Vector/Depth to this accumulator.
decisionRule.nextIfSupported: Preregister a real Blender multipart holdout that calibrates Vector component/direction and converts B47 passes into the D9 canonical input convention.
decisionRule.nextIfNotSupported: Repair the externally defined validity/accumulation algorithm under a new preregistration before using production passes.

nonClaims: D9 uses analytic integer motion and does not validate Blender Vector component order or sign.
D9 does not validate subpixel reprojection, transparency mixtures, volumetrics, motion blur, depth of field or arbitrary Cryptomatte coverage.
D9 does not claim temporal denoising quality, anti-aliasing quality, cinematic quality or human preference.
D8 transport is reused only for final resolved RGBA; it does not validate semantic input extraction.
A passing D9 requires a separate real Blender multipart holdout before production use.
